The crisis has been here for a few weeks now and caught us in the middle of preparing our project. Being flexible, instead of sitting on our hands we decided to film a few coaching lessons for the boys and girls from our club MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany . The first piece is more of an attempt to produce something that makes sense without a camera, a microphone or any directing experience.

For now we're going for less information and more watching, so we'll see what feedback we get from our training group.
